# Production Agent Engineering: An FDE Field Guide

Purpose: production AI agent architecture, evaluation, security, deployment, and operations.
License: Apache-2.0

Primary index: catalog.json
Project controls (normative within this guide): controls/control-catalog.json
Artifact contracts: schemas/
Copy-ready artifacts: templates/
Reference architectures: blueprints/
Executable reference: examples/invoice-exception/
Release and operations: operations/
Engineering rationale: library/
Dated evidence: research/
Contribution contract: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md
Security reports: SECURITY.md

Design artifact sequence:
1. templates/fde-discovery-pack.md
2. templates/operational-ontology.json
3. templates/agent-system.json
4. templates/tool-contract.json
5. templates/evaluation-case.json
6. templates/threat-model.json
7. operations/release-gates.md

Validation: npm ci && npm test && git diff --check
